title.narrative: Public-private development partnership to support industrial skills development in Guinea#s mineral processing sector

description.narrative: The project is envisaged as a Public Private Development Partnership (PPDP) between ALTEO Alumina, the Ministry of Technical Education, Vocational Training and Employment of Guinea, the Ministry of Higher Education, Scientific Research and Innovation of Guinea, and UNIDO. ALTEO Alumina is a worldwide leader in the production of specialty aluminium, e.g. insulation in lithium-ion batteries and smartphones that support a green transition. The overall objective of the PPDP is to increase the access of Guinean youth to qualified labour opportunities in the country#s mini ng/bauxite/alumina industry. The specific objectives of the project are (i) to establish a private training centre specialised in skills development for the Guinean alumina industry, the Ecole de Formation professionnelle de l#Alumine de Conakry (EFAC) and train 700 Guineans, (ii) to upgrade an existing Vocational Training Centre managed by the Government of Guinea (GoG) through infrastructure rehabilitation, the provision of equipment, training for management and administrative staff, and the delivery of entrepreneurship training, and (ii) to support systemic change in the Guinean skills development sector, by encouraging market actors to connect firm-level training needs with national skills development system.
